newsitem.title: UK: Howden buys Spain's TSL for 9.3 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Howden buys Spain's TSL for 9.3 mln stg.

text.p: Howden Group Plc, the world's largest industrial ventilation and fan supplier, said on Thursday its European fan division had acquired Spain's Talleres Sanchez Luengo SA (TSL) for around 9.3 million stg.

TLS, a manufacturer of air preheaters, which are integrated with fans to recover waste heat on power stations, made an operating profit of 700,000 stg in the year to December 31, when net assets totalled 2.8 million stg.

A sum of 7.3 million stg is to be paid immediately in cash, with a further 800,000 stg due in February 1998. The balance estimated at 1.2 million stg is dependent on turnover for the five years to December 2001, Howden said in a statement.
In March, Howden itself was acquired by British engineering group Charter Plc in an agreed offer valuing it around 378 million stg.
